verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an MCP integration that connects a Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving instant conversational access to financial data with no exports. Its in-product AI also answers plain-English business questions such as "How's my cash trending?" and runs prompts on top of the general ledger, and runway and burn metrics are surfaced, so an agent can ground affordability questions in live ledger data. Missing for 10: documentation of exactly which ledger data and tools the MCP/API exposes and how fresh they are, an explicit "can we afford X?" style example, a public API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
